sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct State‑of‑the‑art vision‑language model capable of understanding images and generating text responses. Qwen2.5‑VL‑7B‑Instruct is a multimodal vision‑language model with 7 billion parameters that can process both images and text, enabling visual question answering, image description, and other vision‑language tasks.

sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.
